18   proclamation from the Governor at the desk?

19                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Yes, 

20   there is.

21                SENATOR DeFRANCISCO:   Can we 

22   please have it read at this time.

23                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   The 

24   Secretary will read the proclamation.

25                THE SECRETARY:   "Pursuant to the 


                                                                5616

 1   power vested in me by Article IV, Section 3 of 

 2   the Constitution, I hereby convene the Senate 

 3   and the Assembly of the State of New York in 

 4   Extraordinary Session, at the Capitol, in the 

 5   City of Albany, on the twenty-eighth day of 

 6   June, two thousand seventeen, at 1:00 p.m., for 

 7   the purpose of considering legislation I will 

 8   submit with respect to:  

 9                "a.  Enacting legislation 

10   memorializing the agreement of the Senate and 

11   the Assembly that would extend mayoral control 

12   of the City School District of the City of 

13   New York for an additional year; specifically, 

14   extending the effectiveness of Chapters 91 of 

15   the Laws of 2002 and 345 of the Laws of 2009 

16   relating to the organization of the City School 

17   District of the City of New York; and 

18                "b.  Such other subjects as I may 

19   recommend.  

20                "Given under my hand and the Privy 

21   Seal of the State in the City of Albany this 

22   twenty-sixth day of June in the year 

23   two thousand seventeen, 

24                "By the Governor, Andrew M. Cuomo."

 4                SENATOR DeFRANCISCO:   I'd like to 

 5   hand up the following resolution and ask for its 

 6   immediate adoption.

 7                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   The 

 8   Secretary will read.

 9                SENATOR DeFRANCISCO:   It's 

10   Resolution Number 1.

11                THE SECRETARY:   Senate Resolution 

12   1, providing for the introduction of bills in the 

13   Senate during the Extraordinary Session.  

14                RESOLVED, That notwithstanding any 

15   provision of the rules to the contrary, all bills 

16   introduced when the Senate is in Extraordinary 

17   Session shall be by the Committee on Rules or on 

18   message from the Assembly, and shall be referred 

19   to the Committee on Rules of the Senate, with the 

20   exception of any bills making an appropriation, 

21   which shall be referred to the Committee on 

22   Finance of the Senate pursuant to Section 23 of 

23   the Legislative Law.

24                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   The 

25   question is on the resolution.  All in favor
